baseline: B = finite nucleon F1(t_N), F2(t_N) times finite-size AFH W_M(y_A)

strange_input_metadata.source: Alexandrou et al., arXiv:2603.26600 (2026), continuum limit at physical quark masses
strange_input_metadata.current: unit strange current sbar gamma_mu s; e_s=-1/3 is explicitly not included in reported results
strange_input_metadata.Q2_dependence: slope-only expansion from published radii; full z-expansion coefficients/covariance not used

electromagnetic_form_factor_source: Borah et al., Phys. Rev. D 102, 074012 (2020), arXiv:2003.13640; pinned coefficients/covariance distributed by GENIE

matching.nuclear_response: AFH v6.0 finite-size W_M; no point-nucleus replacement

uncertainty.strange_lattice_errors: not sampled in this first pass; central-value scenarios are kept separate and source uncertainties are recorded in the form-factor metadata
